openphish.license: OpenPhish community feed: free for non-commercial use, attribution required; commercial use requires subscription
openphish.notes: Active/confirmed phishing URLs. Treat every URL as untrusted data.

urlhaus.license: abuse.ch URLhaus: free to use/share (CC0-style dedication), attribution appreciated; see https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/api/
urlhaus.notes: Recent malware-distribution URLs (csv_recent = recent subset; csv = full archive).

gleif.license: GLEIF LEI data: free and open; see GLEIF terms of use (attribution, no warranty)
gleif.notes: Authoritative legal-entity identities. CH slice is Phase-1 Swiss subset; LEI population skews financial/large firms.

zefix.license: Swiss commercial registry (Zefix); API access requires free registered token; data (c) Confederation/cantons
zefix.notes: Collector interface implemented; blocked until token is registered (see BLOCKED in PROGRESS.md).

rdap.license: Registry RDAP responses; per-registry terms, generally factual registration metadata
rdap.notes: rdap.org redirects to authoritative registry RDAP. Rate-limit friendly: cached per domain, resume-safe.

dns.notes: A/MX/TXT existence via dnspython. NXDOMAIN recorded as dns_error=nxdomain, all False (domain gone).

threatfox.license: abuse.ch ThreatFox: free to use/share, attribution appreciated; non-commercial spirit per abuse.ch terms
threatfox.notes: Recent IOCs (IP:port / URL / domain) with malware type + confidence. CSV has # comment headers.

feodotracker.license: abuse.ch FeodoTracker: free to use/share, attribution appreciated; non-commercial per abuse.ch terms
feodotracker.notes: C2 IP blocklist w/ malware family. JSON preferred, CSV fallback.

malwarebazaar.license: abuse.ch MalwareBazaar: free to use/share, attribution appreciated; API needs free auth key
malwarebazaar.notes: Daily sample blob preferred; API get-recent needs free abuse.ch auth key. Blob+API were 502 via egress proxy 2026-09-24.

sanctions.license: UN consolidated list: public data (c) United Nations; OFAC SDN: US public domain; SECO: Swiss public data via OpenSanctions mirror (CC BY-SA 4.0 on the mirror); EU consolidated list: EU public data but bulk download now sits behind EU Login
sanctions.notes: EU probed 2026-09-24: redirects to EU Login even with ?anonymous=true -> BLOCKED-needs-login. SECO has no stable anonymous bulk URL -> collected via OpenSanctions source.xml mirror.

abuseipdb.license: AbuseIPDB free tier: non-commercial, attribution; responses not for redistribution as-is
abuseipdb.notes: Live since 2026-09-24: key in gitignored .env (LEASH_ABUSEIPDB_KEY); cap-aware resume (950 fresh/run), per-IP cached.

domain_health.license: n/a (protocol lookups; Wayback CDX + crt.sh public services, bounded + cached)
domain_health.notes: DNS MX/NS/A/SPF + HTTP liveness/parked-sniff + Wayback first-seen for all confirmed-malicious root domains; crt.sh bounded sample.

tranco.license: Tranco list: free for research with attribution (see tranco-list.eu); kit excluded data
tranco.notes: Daily aggregated top-1M domain ranking; 307-redirects to /download/daily/top-1m.csv.zip.

majestic.license: Majestic Million: free; attribution required; commercial use needs license (https://majestic.com/reports/majestic-million)
majestic.notes: Top-1M domains by referring subnets/IPs; independent benign-domain reference.

google_taxonomy.license: Google product taxonomy: free to use for product categorization; attribution appreciated
google_taxonomy.notes: Category id -> full path; used for product-category normalization and intent mismatch.

viseca.license: Viseca public synthetic pack (Swiss-ai-Weeks/viseca-2026); synthetic data, license per repo README
viseca.notes: Swiss synthetic authorization/merchant/customer CSVs + JSON schemas; LLM-agent shopping scenario fixtures.

tabformer.license: IBM TabFormer credit-card dataset: synthetic, released for research (IBM/TabFormer repo, CDLA-style research use; see repo)
tabformer.notes: ~24M synthetic transactions (9 users/100 cards era), git-lfs object (266MB tgz). Box fallback: https://ibm.box.com/v/tabformer-data

ieee_cis.license: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection (Kaggle competition data); unofficial HF mirror; research use per competition rules
ieee_cis.notes: Mirror of Vesta/IEEE-CIS train files; verified post-download (row counts / label rate). Official source needs Kaggle creds.

ulb_creditcard.license: ULB Credit Card Fraud dataset (OpenML did 1597); CC BY 4.0 (per OpenML/ULB)
ulb_creditcard.notes: 284,807 PCA transactions, 492 frauds; baseline/benchmark only, not a feature-training source.

hackaprompt.notes: Gated on HF (auto-approve): requires LEASH_HF_TOKEN with accepted terms; collector is token-ready.

bipia.notes: Indirect prompt-injection benchmark: QA/email/table/code/abstract attack+context files.

agentdojo.license: AgentDojo (ETH): MIT (per repo LICENSE); benchmark results included as published
agentdojo.notes: Task suites (banking/workspace/travel/slack) + injection vectors in Python; runs/ holds published attack/utility results.

tensortrust.license: Tensor Trust data: permissively licensed (see repo README; CC0/Apache-2.0 per project)
tensortrust.notes: 126k+ crowdsource prompt-injection attacks / 46k defenses + derived robustness benchmarks.
